body.heading: Where in the world is Comoros?
paragraphs: Comoros is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Comoros is Moroni.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Comoros speak Comorian, Arabic and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Comoros is the Comorian franc.

body.heading: How big is Comoros?
paragraphs: Comoros covers about 2,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Cabo Verde.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Moroni, the capital, has a maze-like old town of coral-stone houses, mosques and a harbour full of wooden boats, all under the shoulder of a volcano.
The island of Mohéli protects its reefs in a marine park where sea turtles nest on the beaches and whales visit the deep blue channels.
